== How to unlock ==
*Defeat the [[Unspeakable Thing]] in Normal-Mode
*You can now select Hardmode when starting a new game
== Changes ==
*Every [[Monsters & Bosses]] has more [[HP]]
*Some [[Monsters & Bosses]] are having different attack patterns
*Access to [[Chapter 4]](Abyss of the Old) and the [[Author]]
